setting: Lord Maetha's training facility, remote world
emotional_trajectory: Every generation thinks they're smarter than the last. The cycle the story will break.
notes: Maetha's warning delivered. Torin argues 'this time will be different.' Veraine has been here too — alchemical notes missing. The wrongness spikes sharply — seal is being deliberately attacked.
